key_insight: TEA-Prompt preserves past knowledge by anchoring a shared prompt’s attention behavior rather than restricting parameter updates.
engineering_relevance: Although not a solid-mechanics study, this approach could inform memory-efficient adaptation of engineering vision models as new inspection classes emerge.
method: Tune a single shared prompt within a frozen pre-trained vision transformer.
Use input-dependent relevance scores to softly specialize prompt tokens through attention logits.
Anchor attention outputs using compact class-specific Gaussian query statistics, weighted by past token relevance, without storing old images.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art accuracy and markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 using 0.38M parameters.
watch_item: Performance on solid-mechanics tasks is untested, and Gaussian query statistics may not capture complex class distributions.
paper_title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
